# UNIUTY University Portal

> A role-based university management portal for the University of Unity, with biometric authentication.

UNIUTY is a demo/prototype web portal for four roles — Administrator, Vice Chancellor, Lecturer, and Student — covering dashboards, courses, results, transcripts, and faculty management. Login supports simulated biometric authentication (fingerprint, retina, facial recognition) alongside password-based sign-in.

This is a client-side demo app (single HTML page, vanilla JS) backed by a separate Node/Express API. It is not currently deployed publicly.

## Stack
Vanilla HTML/CSS/JS frontend, Node/Express + MongoDB backend.
